text:
Camille (CSM): kicking off Vanguard Labs onboarding — quick roll call and proposed 30/60/90 success criteria. tagging the team who will touch this account. happy to adjust timeline based on availability.
Maria (AE): thanks! can you paste the stakeholder list from the intake? i only have high-level contacts.
Camille (CSM): pasted below — primary users: @vanguard-pm (product lead), @vanguard-platform (infra lead), @vanguard-security (compliance). Contract: dedicated capacity, quarter 1 start, 6-mo pilot.
James (Onboarding): timeline proposal: week 0 = discovery + access, week 1–2 = model mapping & prompts, week 3 = integration spike, week 4 = internal enablement + pilot kickoff. 30/60/90 success criteria I suggest: 30d = secure API access, basic integration end-to-end; 60d = latency and cost baseline within SLA targets; 90d = feature flag rollout + stakeholder signoff for production plan.
Liam (Solutions Eng): confirm we have VPC details? need VPN + allowlist before we can run Private deploy tests. also will prepare a sample prompt set for model evals.
Camille (CSM): @Liam we have VPC CIDR and initial contact (vanguard-platform). i'll DM the details.
Olivia (Engineer): FYI — I'll own the initial integration adapter (python SDK) and a small test harness. ETA for PR: end of week 2.
Maria (AE): customer's primary risk is renewal timing — procurement timeline shifts could push their go-live. propose weekly 30-min sync with procurement until order is finalized.
Camille (CSM): agreed. Risk mitigations: (1) milestone-based enablement (demo at 30/60) to keep momentum, (2) procurement checklist + ready-to-sign bundle from sales, (3) fallback plan to hosted API if private deploy delays.
James (Onboarding): action items: capture access matrix (who has keys), get sample traffic estimate, prompt checklist, and a success signoff template. i'll create a shared doc and checklist.
onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: "Vanguard Labs Onboard — Week 0 Discovery" Thu 11am PT. Link: https://cal.example/abc123
Camille (CSM): can everyone react with :thumbsup: when you confirm the owner for your item? i'll finalize the kickoff deck after that.
Liam (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup: i'll own prompt eval and quantization guidance.
Olivia (Engineer): :thumbsup: adapter + harness.
James (Onboarding): :thumbsup: doc + checklist.
Maria (AE): :thumbsup: procurement cadence & stakeholder comms.
Camille (CSM): great. two quick asks for the thread: 1) please add any non-standard compliance asks from Vanguard Security to the shared doc before EOD Tuesday, 2) if anyone needs sandbox capacity bumped for week 2 testing, let me know by Monday.
Maria (AE): noted — i'll surface any procurement constraints in the doc.
Liam (Solutions Eng): quick question — what's the expected max seq len / typical payload? will affect kernel selection.
Camille (CSM): client says mostly short messages (<=512 tokens) but a few long context cases. i'll add sample examples to the doc.
Olivia (Engineer): i'll size the adapter for 1k max just in case.
James (Onboarding): one more — capture a simple NPS/qual feedback pulse at 30 & 90 days. helps with quality/regression tracking.
Camille (CSM): good call. i'll add feedback capture to the enablement agenda. any objections to weekly 30-min syncs (team + Vanguard PM) for the first 6 weeks?
Maria (AE): no objections. keeps procurement and exec updates tight.
Liam (Solutions Eng): good. can we include a brief perf checklist in the invite so Vanguard knows what we'll measure?
Camille (CSM): yes — i'll attach perf checklist + expected dashboards from Redwood Console.
Maria (AE): wrapping up — thanks team. i'll join the discovery call and lead procurement touches.
Camille (CSM): thanks all — i'll publish the kickoff doc & checklist now and post the link here when done.
onboard-bot: Shared doc created: https://docs.example/vanguard-onboard-checklist (access: team only)
Camille (CSM): link posted ^. meeting invite confirmed. last note: please keep replies short in this thread (we'll use the doc for detailed items).
